financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Public offering plus concurrent Invus private placement of 34,000,000 shares at $2.50 (closing date not stated; August 2022, day approximated)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In August 2022, Lexicon sold an aggregate of 34,000,000 shares of its common stock at a price of $2.50 per share

warrants.quote: Lexicon granted Oxford a warrant to purchase 420,673 shares of Lexicon’s common stock at an exercise price of $2.08 per share. The warrant is exercisable through March 1, 2027
